summary: Defined AgentOS artifact coordinate, manifest, file, dependency, activation requirement and trust binding schema.
acceptance_evidence: AgentOsArtifactManifestV1 binds coordinate, artifact digest, runtime contract version, compatibility, dependencies, files, activation requirements, trust and replay path.
Manifest validation rejects invalid digest prefixes, invalid versions and unknown required fields.
ActivationRequirement requires AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine, exact approval and preservation of core invariants.
blocked_shortcuts: Unknown required manifest fields fail closed.
Invalid kind, version or digest cannot be accepted.
Manifest activation requirements cannot omit AgentCore PlanSpec or SecurityExecutionEngine.
optional_dependencies: Optional dependencies are represented explicitly and cannot fall back to host mutation.
promotion_impact: Gives local fixtures and future registries a deterministic artifact identity and manifest contract.
